definition: At one price level of a bar, aggressive buying at the ask against aggressive selling at the bid one level below (or the mirror for the sell side), as a ratio; an imbalance when it passes the ratio threshold.
boundaries: Needs the trade tape with the aggressor side. ATAS ships 150% as its setting and teaches 200% and 400% as standard; the threshold is the binding's. On cTrader every reading is a broker-side estimate (the fallback chain), never executed volume.
recognition: A buy imbalance at a level reads as buyers overwhelming the offer there.

class_meanings.fx: No central tape or book exists; any reading is a broker-side estimate from one broker's quotes and depth.
class_meanings.metal: Spot metal CFDs carry broker quotes only, so the reading is a broker-side estimate.
class_meanings.index_cfd: The CFD carries broker quotes, not the index future's tape, so the reading is a broker-side estimate.
class_meanings.commodity_cfd: Broker quotes only, so the reading is a broker-side estimate.
class_meanings.stock_cfd: Broker quotes only, so the reading is a broker-side estimate.
class_meanings.future: The exchange's own tape and book: the reading as its source means it.
class_meanings.perp: The venue's own tape and book, one venue among several.
class_meanings.spot_crypto: The venue's own tape and book, one venue among several.
class_meanings.stock: The exchange's tape, split across venues.

sources.quote: By default, the imbalance threshold is set to 150%
The 200% and 400% thresholds are standard and can be adjusted

fallback.expected_loss: an estimate from resting size: the bid against the ask size near the price stands in for executed aggression, and on cTrader the book is the broker's own, so it is a broker-side estimate
a broker-side estimate by the tick rule: a quote that moves up counts as buying and one that moves down as selling, with no traded size behind either
an estimate from the bar alone: where the close sits in the range (bar-range-pressure@1) stands in for who pressed, with no size at all
